source: Windows System.Speech; Microsoft Zira Desktop; en-US synthetic voice reading fictional England property scenarios. Not human or British-accent validation.

cases.text: The viewing in London is on Friday at ten in the morning.
The monthly rent in Manchester is one thousand two hundred pounds.
The Bristol flat has two bedrooms and a private garden.
The house in Leeds has no garden and no parking space.
Please call the Nottingham office before arranging a viewing.
The Oxford cottage is available from the first of November.
The buyer in Cambridge needs a step free entrance.
The Brighton apartment costs three hundred thousand pounds.
Please cancel the viewing in Sheffield on Monday afternoon.
The Liverpool tenant reported a broken boiler this morning.

notes: WER normalization removes punctuation and case only; number words are not rewritten to digits.
Clean and noisy clips share one synthetic voice; results are not a population-quality estimate.
